cases.situation: Got rejected after 4 rounds for a product designer role at a fintech. The hiring manager, Lauren, was great throughout. I want to ask for feedback without sounding bitter.
cases.reply: Hi Lauren, thanks for telling me directly, and for how thoughtful the whole process was; I really enjoyed the portfolio review with your team. Four rounds and a case study is a real investment on both sides, so if you're able to share it: was there one thing that would have tipped it my way? A single line is plenty, and it's fine if you can't. Congratulations on the hire.

cases.situation: Tenho uma pequena agência em Lisboa. Fizemos proposta para o rebranding de uma rede de padarias e escolheram outra agência. O contacto era o Rui, diretor de marketing.
cases.reply: Olá Rui, obrigada pela decisão e pelo briefing tão claro ao longo do processo. Se puder, gostava de saber se pesou mais o preço, a abordagem ou o encaixe, para apresentarmos melhor da próxima vez. Uma palavra chega. E se o projeto precisar de reforço mais à frente, estamos por cá.
cases.note: Uma pergunta estreita e barata de responder tem mais hipóteses de receber resposta do que «tem algum feedback?».

cases.situation: Final interview for an ops manager role at St. Luke's hospital on Sept 10. Recruiter Dev said I'd hear by the 18th. Nothing. I sent a check-in on the 23rd, still nothing.
cases.reply: Hi Dev, I'll take the silence as a no and close this on my end. Thanks for the conversations, I enjoyed meeting the team at St. Luke's, and I'm open to talking again if anything changes.
cases.note: This is the second and last touch. Then stop; if they come back months later, you can still say yes.

cases.situation: 公司内部竞聘组长，我进了最后一轮但没选上，选了同组的小周。部门领导李总昨天当面跟我说的结果。我以后还要天天跟他们一起工作。
cases.reply: 李总，谢谢您昨天专门抽半小时当面跟我说结果，面试时您问得很细，我也收获不少。结果我接受，小周当组长我会全力配合。想请您帮个小忙：下次再有类似机会，您觉得我最需要补的是哪一块？您哪天有空花十分钟聊聊就行，最近忙的话不着急。
cases.note: Internal rejection: the public support for the winner matters as much as the feedback ask.

cases.situation: Rejected for a senior PM role at Tidewell. I asked the hiring manager, Omar, for one thing that would have changed it. He said my product sense was strong but my answers on metrics were vague, and they needed someone who sets targets up front. It stings, but it's fair.
cases.reply: That's useful, Omar, thank you for being straight with me. Naming the target and how I'd measure it before anything else is exactly what I'll work on. If the team is hiring again in the spring, I'd like another shot.
cases.note: Replying to feedback that stings: thank him, repeat the point back so he knows it landed, and don't defend the old answers.

cases.situation: 想申请明年的直博，给北大环境学院的周教授发邮件自荐，他很快回复说今年名额已经满了，建议我考虑其他老师。我还是很想跟他做土壤修复方向。
cases.reply: 周老师您好，谢谢您这么快回复，还专门看了我的材料。今年名额的情况我明白了。我对您组里土壤修复的工作一直很感兴趣，明年九月如果您组里有名额，我可以再给您发邮件吗？不方便的话不用回复。祝您工作顺利。
cases.note: 学术场合同样适用：谢具体的事，一句接受，只提一个小请求，并允许对方不回。

cases.situation: J'étais en dernière étape pour un poste de chef de projet digital chez un éditeur à Lyon. La recruteuse, Camille, m'écrit que le poste est gelé jusqu'à nouvel ordre pour des raisons de budget. J'aimerais qu'elle pense à moi pour la suite.
cases.reply: Bonjour Camille, merci de m'avoir prévenu aussi vite, et pour la clarté des échanges tout au long du processus. Je comprends tout à fait. Pourriez-vous me garder en tête si le poste rouvre, ou pour un rôle similaire de chef de projet digital dans les prochains mois ? Je vous enverrai volontiers un CV à jour quand ce sera utile. Belle journée à vous.
cases.note: Poste gelé : une seule demande, être gardé en tête, sans réclamer de retour sur les entretiens dans le même message.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance journalist. I pitched a feature on rural bus cuts to Dana, features editor at Northline Magazine. She replied 'Not quite right for us, but thanks for thinking of us.' I'd really like to write for them eventually.
cases.reply: Thanks for the quick answer, Dana, and for reading it. Understood on the bus piece. One quick question, only if it takes you under a minute: is there a kind of story you're short of for the winter issues? A single line is plenty, and it's fine to skip it.
cases.note: A pitch rejection: ask what they need, not why they said no. Editors answer that question, and it makes the next pitch land.

cases.situation: 9月15号在一家新能源车企面了最后一轮，HR王女士说9月22号前给结果，到今天一直没消息。想问一下，又怕显得太着急。
cases.reply: 王女士您好，想跟您确认一下产品运营岗位的结果，之前您提到9月22日前会有消息。如果这次没有通过，回我一句就好，我也好安排后面的计划。感谢您这段时间的安排。
cases.note: 过了对方给的日期几个工作日再问，只问一次，把“没通过”说成可以轻松回复的选项；一周后仍无回音就发结束语，不再追。

cases.situation: Founder here. Kara, a partner at Northfield Ventures, passed on our seed round after two meetings. Her email said 'too early for us, love the team.' I'd like her to invest later without sounding desperate.
cases.reply: Thanks, Kara, and thank you for two genuinely useful meetings; your question about repeat purchase rates changed how we're tracking the pilot. Understood on timing. Would it be alright if I sent you a short update in January, once we have three months of paying customers? If not, no need to reply. Good luck with the new fund.
cases.note: An investor pass is usually a timing no: ask for one permission to update, tied to a date and a milestone, and skip the feedback ask.

cases.situation: My friend Nadia referred me for an analyst role at her company, Brightline. I got rejected after the second round yesterday. I want to thank her without making her feel bad or like she has to find out why.
cases.reply: Hey Nadia, heard back from Brightline, it's a no after round two. Thank you for putting my name in, it got me a real interview and I liked the team a lot. Please don't feel you need to dig into it or put in a word, you've already done plenty. Drinks on me Friday?
cases.note: The referrer is the relationship to protect: thank her, release her from chasing it, and take any feedback ask to the hiring manager instead.

cases.situation: I interviewed for Marketing Manager at Fernhill Foods. The hiring manager, Grace, emailed that they went with someone with more team management experience, but suggested I apply for a Senior Marketing Specialist role opening next month. I'm deflated, but I'd consider it.
cases.reply: Hi Grace, thanks for letting me know, and for thinking of me for the specialist role; I really enjoyed our conversation about the spring launches. I understand the decision. I'd like to be considered for the Senior Marketing Specialist position, so could you let me know when it opens? Good luck to your new manager.
cases.note: Take the pointer seriously but don't commit to a lower title yet; ask to be considered, then judge the role once you see the pay and scope.

cases.situation: I submitted a talk proposal to DevNorth, a regional developer conference, on how we split our monolith into services. The program chair, Elena, emailed that it wasn't selected this year out of 240 submissions. I'd really like to speak there one day.
cases.reply: Thanks for letting me know, Elena, and for reviewing so carefully with 240 proposals to get through. Understood on this year's program. One quick question, only if it takes you under a minute: was there one thing that would have made the proposal stronger? A single line is plenty, and it's fine to skip it. I'll be in the audience in March either way.
cases.note: A talk committee reads hundreds of proposals: one narrow question, and showing up anyway is what gets you remembered next year.
